description: Behavior decision tree for AI UGC Ads — system rules (mandatory) + user rules (opt-in)

conditions.is-user-content: no generatedVideoUrl AND (generatedImageUrl OR sourceMediaUrl) exists

systemRules.description: Avatar lip-sync videos never play embedded audio — TTS voiceover track handles audio
Avatar scenes always send TTS as driving audio for lip-sync
Product animation never sends driving audio — product cannot lip-sync

userRules.description: Enable embedded audio for product animation videos (Wan 2.7/Seedance ambient effects)
